title: The Painted Confession Anew
author: Rosalind Thornbury
blurb: Freya Zhou, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
